question: Where is Devi Ahilya Bai Holkar Airport located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Devi Ahilyabai Holkar Airport **is an** international airport.**
 
• It primarily serves **Madhya Pradesh, cities of Indore **and its surrounding areas.
